{{Quote|We will leave as soon as Queen Neeyutnee's banquet is over.|Palpatine to Anakin Skywalker, marching towards the Banquet Hall|<ref name="TCW" />}}
The '''Theed Palace Banquet Hall''' was a vaulted room for the purpose of hosting an official reception in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="Crisis8">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep418|text="Crisis on Naboo" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 8}}</ref> A set of [[Tapestry/Legends|tapestries]] displayed in the Banquet Hall depicted the hisrory of the Naboo, from the crash of the colony ship ''[[Beneficent Tasia]]'', to a nomadic tribe arriving at the [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]], and on to the growing prosperity of Theed.<ref name="Ffp34">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 34|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 34]]</ref> The Banquet Hall also contained a statue<ref name="Crisis7">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep418|text="Crisis on Naboo" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 7}}</ref> over five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high<ref name="Height">A concept artwork of the statue shows that it is three times as high as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. According to ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', the clone troopers all measured 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The height of the statue can be obtained by multiplying that of a standard clone trooper by three, which gives 5.49 meters.</ref> depicting a [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]] holding a globe and a scepter in her hands.<ref name="Crisis7" />

At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], awaited the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in an ambush. Unbeknownst to the Jedi, the trap had been secretly arranged by the Chancellor, who concealed his membership of the malevolent [[Order of the Sith Lords]]. At the time, the room contained one large table bordered by twenty-one chairs, one of which was placed at the top end of the table.<ref name="TCW" />
